content.text: Digital creators often face barriers when attempting to set up online stores, particularly in regions where platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-11|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/what-nobody-warns-you-about-payment-methods-filipino-3|COREMERCH guide to nobody]]-tells-you-19|stripe]] and PayPal are unavailable. In countries like Nigeria and Zimbabwe, traditional payment processors can hinder growth and accessibility. COREMERCH provides a robust solution to these challenges by leveraging Sovereign Stacks, allowing you to build a fully functional digital store with automated crypto payment processing. This guide presents a step-by-step approach to using Supabase as your order database, ensuring seamless transactions without relying on conventional platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The primary advantage of using COREMERCH's infrastructure lies in its independence from conventional payment processors. When platforms like Stripe fail to serve specific regions, creators can leverage GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, alongside Supabase, to maintain control over their sales operations. The combination of open-source tools ensures that you own your data and can operate without ongoing fees or subscriptions. This architecture stands resilient against financial instability and payment rejections, enabling creators to transact in a secure and sovereign manner.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To effectively set up your digital store using Supabase, you need to prepare a few essential components. Firstly, establish your GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your store. Next, create a Supabase account to manage your order database. Familiarize yourself with the NOWPayments integration, which allows for seamless crypto payment processing. Ensure you have digital products ready for upload, including ebooks or courses, and gather all necessary API keys and configurations. This preparation phase sets the groundwork for a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your accounts are ready, begin by deploying your backend infrastructure. For Stack 01, this involves configuring GitHub Pages with Google Apps Script to handle order processing. After setting up the backend, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. With your payment pipeline established, focus on automating product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This ensures that once payment is confirmed, customers receive their digital products instantly. Testing this pipeline thoroughly will help identify and resolve any potential issues before going live.
Full control over your data means no platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

When your infrastructure is in place and tested, it's time to go live. Update your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages with your store details and ensure that all links to products are functional. Promote your store through social media channels or other outreach strategies. As customers start to make purchases, monitor the transaction process closely. Utilize the insights gained from initial transactions to fine-tune your setup and streamline future sales. By effectively managing your first sales, you lay a solid foundation for continued growth.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, consider avenues for scaling your business. Expand your product offerings by adding more digital goods and leveraging the capabilities of Supabase for order management. Explore different marketing strategies to attract more customers, and optimize your payment processing by adjusting your NOWPayments settings to cater to various cryptocurrencies. Regularly evaluate your infrastructure, looking for enhancements or additional tools that can increase efficiency and improve customer experience. Scalability is crucial for long-term success, so continually assess your operational capacity.

Use Supabase as your order database, and integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Explore available products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
